title: kbmon's sprint panel builds its own sprint row, without the percentage the status row shows
goal: the sprint panel of the kbmon view writes each sprint's row with the same function as the --status sprints compact row (short name, state, done of total, percentage, ETA, within 100 characters, the same not-active wording), so the view and the status answer show one row from one implementation

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
long='The paid multi-agent runs measure concurrency, dedup, cache reuse, model choice, pack budget and kb tools'
SP=[{'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','state':'approved','title':'An approved sprint','items':{'todo':3},'next':None,'next_title':None,'open':[],'done_at':[],'waiting':[]},
    {'id':'SP-bbbbbbbb','state':'active','title':long,'items':{'done':4,'todo':5,'doing':1},'next':'ST-cccccccc','next_title':'Next item title',
     'open':[{'id':'ST-cccccccc','title':'Next item title','status':'todo'}],'done_at':['2026-10-19T0%d:00:00Z'%h for h in range(1,6)],'waiting':[]}]
snap={'schema':1,'taken':'2026-10-19T08:00:00Z','alerts':[],'panels':{'sprint':{'state':'ok','seconds':0.1,'data':{'sprints':SP,'source':'origin/main','behind':0,'landings':[]}},
      'host':{'state':'ok','seconds':0.1,'data':{'load':[1.0,1.0,1.0],'cores':8}}}}
f=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'s.json');json.dump(snap,open(f,'w'))
r=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a,'--from-snapshot',f],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,env=dict(os.environ,COLUMNS='200')).stdout
st=[l.strip() for l in r('--status','sprints').splitlines() if '4/10' in l]
pn=[l.strip() for l in r('--once','--panel','sprint').splitlines() if '4/10' in l]
print('status:',st);print('panel:',pn)
sys.exit(0 if st and pn and '40%' in pn[0] and 'ETA' in pn[0] and len(pn[0])<=100 else 1)

notes: SP-2uljwgho review gap 1 (S1): mon_sprint.progress/lines (_tools/mon_sprint.py:226) and mon_status.sprint_row (_tools/mon_status.py:319) are two implementations; on the planted snapshot the panel row reads 'SP-bbbbbbbb  active  The paid multi-agent runs measure…  4/10 done · next ST-cccccccc · todo 5, done 4, doing 1' (no percentage, no ETA) while the status row reads '… active 4/10 40% no ETA yet'.
